| description = Like trigger spawned Venril Sathir and Faydedar for the ranger/druid epics, the bard epic spawned Trakanon has a limited loot pool compared to real Trakanon, only dropping the undead dragongut strings and one other item from its loot list (except teeth. no teeth).

=== Strategy ===

Trakanon is a medium-difficulty encounter which requires several clerics, several solid tanks, and a lot of dps. High dps is important, you must kill Trakanon before his AOE DoT melts your raid. 

Trakanon is accompanied by a group of [[sebilite juggernaut]]s, the [[sebilite protector]], and [[Tolapumj]] in his lair. When uncontested, it's recommended to clear these first, as they will likely aggro your raid. When contested, several enchanters can attempt to control them with [[Rapture]] and [[Dictate]].

Trakanon himself casts a banish with a cooldown of several ticks on the tank or whoever has top hate. This banish teleports the player to a dangerous spot in the eastern mushroom maze where they will likely die. You can have one Necromancer or Paladin use [[Harmshield]] or [[Divine Aura]] to temporarily tank Trakanon and eat the first banish before sending in a Warrior to engage. Trakanon also casts a blind on the tank, so it's helpful to have healers ready with Cure Blindness.
